name: Suzuki Kazuki
source:
"Let's go! My explosive new song!"

A member of the SRX team that everybody considers to be eccentric.
His words and actions are quite unpredictable, the team mood-maker, he often sprinkles random English into his sentences.
The type that works hard when he has to, but it often doesn't look that way to others
He has great passion and talent when it comes to music however.
He plays keyboard for the Odd-I's band and writes songs.
The songs he write have a good harmony, but the lyrics are complete nonsense.
He doesn't like his own last name and gets mad when people say it.
His partner Substance is [url=/c30014]Rickenbacker[/url].
